includes: Pre-flight briefing with pilot and ground support team
Champagne toast and custom champagne cup after flight
Flight navigation explanation and hands-on balloon inflation participation
blurb: Guests start with a pre-flight briefing, then launch a hot air balloon for about an hour of flight, viewing swamps, forests, resorts, and wildlife. Flights occur at sunrise and last about 45 minutes to an hour depending on conditions. After landing, there is a champagne toast and presentation of a custom champagne cup.
extraNote: Flights are weather permitting; safety is top priority · Deposits required to secure flight date: $264 for two-person private, $75 per person for shared flights · Deposit good for 6 months; if weather cancels flight, choose another day or get 50% refund of deposit · Cancellation policy requires deposit to secure reservation; no deposit means date open to others · Pilot in command has final authority on tethered balloon operations · Winn Dixie parking area 28047 US Hwy 27, Dundee Florida 33838
